_help: Edit freely. Add roles, requirements and steps as needed. Set 'open' to false to show applications as closed.
intro: Want to help run TeamFlick? Here's what we look for and how to apply.
general: Be respectful and mature when dealing with players and other staff.
Know and follow all server rules.
Follow the instructions of senior staff.

roles.name: Support
roles.description: Help players with questions and issues.
requirements: Patient and friendly with new players

roles.name: Moderator
roles.description: Keep the server fair and enforce the rules.
requirements: Experience as Support or a strong track record in the community
Good judgement when handling rule breaks

howToApply.title: How to apply
steps: Open a ticket and say which role you want.
Tell us a bit about yourself and why you'd be a good fit.
Wait for a response from the team.
howToApply.note: Requirements may change at any time. Applying doesn't guarantee a position.
